title: Length of the generated gate list
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite type, let $m,w,n$ be natural numbers, let $F$ assign a list of Boolean values to each element of $\kappa$ and each input list of Boolean values, and let $z$ be a list of Boolean values. For every natural number $i$ and every finite list of instructions whose kinds lie in $\kappa$, the list of gates generated from those instructions starting at index $i$ has length $(m+\mathrm{tabG}(m,w,F)+w)$ times the number of instructions.
hypotheses_covered: A finite program, represented by a list of instructions over $\kappa$
